steps.command: xxd main.db | head -20 && echo "---WAL HEADER---" && xxd main.db-wal | head -8 && echo "---FILES---" && file main.db main.db-wal

python3 -c "
data = open('main.db-wal','rb').read()
dec = bytes(b ^ 0x42 for b in data)
print('len', len(data))
print('header:', dec[:32].hex())
print('magic: %08x' % int.from_bytes(dec[0:4],'big'))
print('version:', int.from_bytes(dec[4:8],'big'))
print('pagesize:', int.from_bytes(dec[8:12],'big'))
print('frames check: (len-32)/(24+pagesize) =', (len(data)-32)/(24+int.from_bytes(dec[8:12],'big')))
print('first frame header:', dec[32:56].hex())
open('main.db-wal.dec','wb').write(dec)
"

python3 -c "
import struct
d=open('main.db-wal.dec','rb').read()
ps=4096
for i in range(4):
    off=32+i*(24+ps)
    h=d[off:off+24]
    pgno=struct.unpack('>I',h[0:4])[0]
    dbsz=struct.unpack('>I',h[4:8])[0]
    print('frame',i+1,'pgno',pgno,'dbsize',dbsz,'salt',h[8:16].hex())
"
